title: Automating eval design and hillclimbing with Claude
summary: Anthropic published guidance on designing evals and hillclimbing without overfitting, shipped as two claude-api skill commands. `/claude-api build-eval` interviews you, samples production-like inputs, proposes the cheapest suitable grader, and runs diagnostics, while `/claude-api hillclimb` splits train and test sets and keeps each proposed patch only if both sets improve. Examples include an ~80% cut in cost per ticket with better held-out accuracy, and a skill run that rose from 66% to about 88%.

title: Claude now works with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides
summary: Claude for Google Workspace is in public beta as an add-on on all paid plans, with a sidebar that reads the open file and selection and edits in place, such as restyling Docs, writing Sheets formulas and charts, or building Slides from deck layouts. "Ask before edits" and "Accept all edits" modes control approval, and new Docs, Sheets, and Slides connectors (beta) let main chat create and edit Google files within sharing permissions. Existing connectors, skills, and enterprise controls carry over.

title: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
summary: Anthropic expanded the Cyber Verification Program by merging Project Glasswing and the original CVP into three tiers (Defense, Red Team, and Specialized) that give vetted security professionals access to its most capable models, including Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Mythos 5.1, with reduced cyber blocking classifiers. Red Team review takes weeks, Specialized is limited to organizations reviewed with the US government, and participants must retain data so Anthropic can monitor misuse. The expansion extends this work to more teams, following Glasswing partners finding at least 129,000 verified vulnerabilities from April to July 2026.

title: How Block orchestrates Claude Fable across thousands of pull requests
summary: In an interview, Block's Bradley Axen describes using Claude Fable 5 to orchestrate large code migrations, with Fable handling high-level design and directing smaller Opus and Sonnet models for edits and tests on the open-source workspace Buzz. About 1,000 Fable-orchestrated PRs were merged in a single migration, and cheaper models handle routine work, with model and effort level treated as optimization variables. Humans still require two approvals for merges to main and for prod deploys.

title: Build live dashboards and animate explainers with Claude
summary: Anthropic announced Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion. Dashboards generate live, plain-language reports from BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, and Salesforce that refresh with the data and link numbers to their queries (beta on paid plans), while Motion creates editable animations from a prompt that can be exported as MP4 (beta on Team and Enterprise). Docs, Slides, and Design have left beta and are available on all plans including Free, Claude Design has moved into conversations, and claude.ai/design closes December 14.

title: Claude Code in the cloud: a field guide to cloud sessions
summary: Cloud sessions run Claude Code on an isolated VM with the repo cloned to a new branch, and the output is a branch or pull request. They can be started from claude.ai/code, mobile, Desktop, the terminal (`claude --cloud`), or Slack, and they run without your laptop so parallel tasks do not collide. The GitHub token stays outside the VM, `~/.claude` config does not carry over (so repo CLAUDE.md should hold shared settings), and sessions are included in Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise while sharing usage limits.
